successCriteria.description: src/shared/types/leave.ts exports LeaveType enum with exactly three string members: ANNUAL='ANNUAL', SICK='SICK', EMERGENCY='EMERGENCY'
src/shared/types/leave.ts exports LeaveRequestStatus enum with exactly five string members: DRAFT='DRAFT', SUBMITTED='SUBMITTED', APPROVED='APPROVED', REJECTED='REJECTED', CANCELLED='CANCELLED'
src/shared/types/leave.ts exports BalanceStatus enum with exactly three string members: ACTIVE='ACTIVE', EXHAUSTED='EXHAUSTED', FROZEN='FROZEN'
src/shared/types/index.ts barrel re-exports all three enums (LeaveType, LeaveRequestStatus, BalanceStatus) from ./leave
Jest unit tests in tests/unit/shared/types/leave.test.ts verify each enum has the correct members and correct member count (3, 5, 3 respectively)

constraints: Enums must use TypeScript string enum syntax (e.g., ANNUAL = 'ANNUAL') — not numeric enums, not const enums
Barrel export in index.ts must use named re-exports: `export { LeaveType, LeaveRequestStatus, BalanceStatus } from './leave'`
No dependencies on any other modules or phases — this is a leaf foundation module
outOfScope: Additional LeaveType members (UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY) mentioned in ARCHITECTURE.md — deferred to later phases; this phase only delivers ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY
Database tables, repositories, services, controllers, routes — all deferred to Phases 2–10
State transition rules, business logic, validation — deferred to later phases
